description: A CI failure the operator asked the session to fix, then report
message: This session is subscribed to CI notices. When a failure notice arrives, fix what it reports in the workspace and then tell me what you changed.

sources.name: ci
sources.guide: CI notices from the pipeline. Each reports a failed build or test run.

types.description: A CI job failed; the body carries the failing check and its output.

events.title: job failed: unit tests
events.body:
`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` failed in the pipeline's contract suite, a check the workspace does not run:

FAIL: test_normalize_lowercases (tests.test_contract.ContractTest)
AssertionError: 'Hello' != 'hello'

The contract test requires normalize(" Hello ") == "hello": trim the surrounding spaces and lowercase the result.

probes.text: normalize trims and lowercases, so the workspace code behaves as the CI notice says it must
the operator is told what changed after the failure was fixed
